title: Episode 109 opens with Bhai Taru Singh's ordeal

blocks.text: This transition page closes the Babur sequence and clearly opens Episode 109 with the story of Bhai Taru Singh. The heading itself frames the ordeal as a test to keep the faith till his last breath, shifting from imperial prophecy to Sikh martyrdom and steadfastness.

Bhai Taru Singh explains his position to the gathered Sikhs and is then taken away toward Lahore by Mughal officials. The congregation responds with prayer, asking that he remain victorious in spirit even as the state begins to impose its punishment.

The page also sketches the severity of the prison scene, contrasting Mughal coercion with Taru Singh's calm acceptance of divine will. Its proper narrative function is to mark the handoff into his martyrdom episode rather than to continue the Babur material named in the stale metadata.
